$comment: #1410 — check-*.mjs scripts legitimately NOT reachable from scripts/check-all.mjs (directly or transitively via the check-anti-fake-green GUARDS aggregate). Mirrors the optional-emissions.json rationale style: every entry MUST carry a non-empty rationale. The check-orchestrator-coverage gate is ADVISORY in this wave; promotion to a fail-closed gate is a tracked follow-up.

allowlist.rationale: Consumed by scripts/gold-report.mjs (the gold-kit doc-governance reporter), not the per-PR check-all orchestrator. It grades the canonical doc-SET against standards/gold-doc-set.yml — a reporting concern, run on demand and inside gold-report, not a fast L1 gate step.

npm tarball size budget — a release/CI-time concern (warn-only by default), not a per-PR L1 gate. Belongs to the packaging lane, deliberately kept out of the fast self-gate so a routine source edit never pays a pack cost.

Published-tarball leak guard (no docs/internal/** or *.arbiter-backup in the package) — a release/publish-boundary concern wired into prepublishOnly --strict and the 05-release build-superset early signal, mirroring check-pack-size. Runs `npm pack`, too heavy for the per-PR L1 gate; deliberately kept in the packaging lane.

T4 (gold-doc-tranches-t3-t5.md §2.3) — per-doc freshness is deliberately NOT in check-all.mjs's L2 pre-push gate: the solo-dev gate-model doctrine (docs/design/solo-developer-gate-model.md) keeps the paved-road pre-push fast and reserves freshness for the async monthly lane (wired directly into the monthly workflow, HARD) plus one release-blocking step. check-monthly-freshness.mjs (a different axis — monthly LANE liveness, not doc content) stays the only freshness-shaped gate check-all.mjs itself runs.
